bio: The Mandeville Hotel is located in the fashionable Marylebone Village, within a few minutes walk of the shops of Oxford Street between two of London's most famous historical large parks, Regents Park and Hyde Park.  Reform Social and Grill, housed within The Mandeville Hotel, was inspired by classic British gentlemen's clubs for both the restaurant's interior design, and food and drink menus. The venue offer`s an informal yet sophisticated experience with quality at the fore and this is demonstrated in its extensive British inspired menu.  Satisfy your appetite with the Traditional Afternoon Tea featuring lemon pound cake, jam roly poly, apple turnover, individual treacle tarts and, of course, the classic scones with clotted cream and jam.  Previously the reserve of floral-flocked ladies, Reform's Gentleman's Afternoon Tea has increasingly become a very popular option. Goodbye cucumber sandwiches and hello steak and snail sandwiches, fish fingers and mushy peas, all your favourite fancies with a side of whiskey or cocktails to choose at the Marylebone cocktail bar.
